name: Two-handed Spirited Charge (Combat)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Handle Animal 10 ranks, Ride 10 ranks, Spirited Charge, Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: When mounted and using the charge action, you make a single melee attack with both weapons you have equipped (including a shield bash). Make your attack rolls separately to determine if each weapon hits your target, but add the damage together for the purposes of overcoming damage resistance and similar abilities.

Both weapons must be used to attack the same foe.
